tools.name: request_human_input
tools.description: End this turn and ask the user to fill one to eight highlighted fields from a fresh snapshot. Never include field values. The user explicitly continues in a fresh turn.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read Shared Browser readiness and current page identity.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Read what a person can see on the page: title, URL, visible text, and indexed interactive elements. Controls a person cannot see yet, such as those in closed menus and drawers, are left out; `omittedControls` counts them, and opening a menu or scrolling may reveal them. `expanded` tells whether a toggle is open, `area` is the part of the page a control sits in, a select's `chosen` is the option it holds, and links on the page's own site are paths. With `tabId`, that tab becomes the one later tools act on first.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate the visible page to a credential-free HTTP(S) URL, or to a path on the current page's site such as a snapshot link's href. With `tabId`, that tab becomes the one later tools act on first.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click one element from a fresh snapshot, emitting the visible AI cursor and action ticker.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type non-sensitive text into one observed element, optionally submitting it.

tools.name: choose
tools.description: Choose one option of a select from a fresh snapshot by the option's label, as the open list shows it. Use it instead of clicking the list. Choosing does not send the form, though some pages send it when a list changes; the form's own button sends it. When no option has that label, the error lists the options.

tools.name: press
tools.description: Press one allowlisted key on one element from a fresh snapshot.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the visible page by bounded horizontal and vertical deltas.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List the tabs this run may use: the page the person chose and the tabs Octo opened, with which one later tools act on. A tab's address and title show once its site is approved in that tab. Each of Octo's tabs has a `label` ("Octo's tab 2") that it keeps while it is open; the person's prompts and browser use the same label, so name tabs by it.

tools.name: open_tab
tools.description: Open a full credential-free HTTP(S) address in a new visible tab of the shared browser and act on it from now on. Octo may have at most three tabs of its own open; they close when this turn ends unless the person keeps them. The site's approval applies in that tab only.

tools.name: select_tab
tools.description: Bring one tab from list_tabs to the front and act on it from now on. Take a fresh snapshot there before using element indices.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close one tab Octo opened in this turn. The page the person chose, their other tabs and tabs they kept are never closed.
